title: NetworkImpairmentParams
description: HX-241 hx-sim NetworkImpairment-compatible parameters. These are derived from XPOCK's physically-based carrier channel models. The values are starting points for hx-sim's ImpairmentEngine and should be calibrated against real carrier measurements.

packet_loss_rate.description: Packet loss rate (0.0-1.0). Derived from path loss: higher loss = higher rate.

duplication_rate.description: Packet duplication rate (0.0-1.0). Typically 0.0 for most carriers.

corruption_rate.description: Packet corruption rate (0.0-1.0). Derived from SNR: lower SNR = higher corruption.

base_latency_us.description: Base propagation latency in microseconds (distance / propagation speed)

jitter_us.description: Additional random latency in microseconds (0 to jitter_us). Derived from delay spread and Doppler.

bandwidth_bps.description: Bandwidth limit in bytes/sec (0 = unlimited). Derived from coherence bandwidth.

enabled.description: Whether this impairment profile is enabled

path_loss_db.description: Path loss in dB (diagnostic, not used by hx-sim directly)

hx241_mapping.invariant: All rate fields must be in [0.0, 1.0]; bandwidth_bps of 0 means unlimited
